label: Role
description: A named job function, such as Agent or Requester, that people hold in a tenant. Roles carry no permissions themselves: permission sets grant access to roles, and workflow transitions can be limited to roles.
usage: Model roles on real job functions, not on individual permissions.
Reuse module roles where they fit; prefix tenant roles with tenant__.
constraints: id is unique and stable; tenant roles start with tenant__.
A role grants nothing until a permission set lists it.
Roles are assigned to members and groups in tenant administration, not in specs.

binding.description: Configuration object in a layer's spec catalog; not a layout node.

spec.label: Agent
spec.description: Works tickets in assigned queues: triages, updates, and resolves them.
